title: Fort Frederik

buildingCutout.basis: Named fort building, including the projecting bastions and the enclosing walls.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified sampled native grade at the seaward wall and sally port entrance.

identities.name: Fort Frederik
identities.address: King Street vicinity, Frederiksted, St. Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands

mapIdentity.scope: Exact mapped outline of the fort building cross-referenced against the captioned NPS exterior photographs, National Historic Landmark building record, and unchanged terrain.

note: Four wings surround a brick court. The west wing contains the two-storey Commandant’s Quarters, an arched passage and two court stairs. The low wings have flat decks with parapets. Red plaster is trimmed white, with shutters and alternating upper pediments.
